# Kineticore Systems Inc.

> Canadian engineering company (British Columbia, serving research and industry
> nationwide) operating in two divisions: (1) Laboratory & DAQ Systems — turnkey
> data acquisition systems, purpose-built acquisition software, secure instrument
> connectivity, calibration and documentation for industrial R&D and research
> laboratories, including the KC-36 thermocouple logger (36 K-type channels,
> ±0.5 °C calibrated accuracy, live visualization, CSV export); (2) Pyrolysis &
> Biochar — an instrumented pyrolysis facility in development that converts wood
> waste into traceable biochar, syngas and heat, with laboratory-grade process
> monitoring. Motto: "Focus on science, not tech."

## Pages

- [Home](https://kineticore.ca/): Company overview of both divisions — Lab & DAQ Systems and Pyrolysis & Biochar.
- [Lab & DAQ Systems](https://kineticore.ca/lab-systems.html): Custom DAQ hardware, purpose-built acquisition software, secure instrument connectivity, full calibration and documentation for research laboratories.
- [Pyrolysis & Biochar](https://kineticore.ca/pyrolysis.html): Instrumented pyrolysis plant converting wood waste into biochar, syngas and heat; feedstock partnerships, biochar supply and toll processing.
- [KC-36 Thermocouple Logger](https://kineticore.ca/kc-36.html): Standalone 36-channel K-type thermocouple logger with ±0.5 °C calibrated accuracy, thresholds, live plots and CSV export.
- [Services](https://kineticore.ca/services.html): End-to-end DAQ and lab-system engineering plus pyrolysis and biochar production services.
- [About](https://kineticore.ca/about.html): Company background and the two-division mission.
- [Contact](https://kineticore.ca/contact.html): Request a technical consultation; form supports topics for DAQ, KC-36 pricing/support, feedstock, biochar purchase and toll processing.
- [Sitemap](https://kineticore.ca/sitemap.xml): XML sitemap of all pages.
